---
title: "Best supportive care — fixed and hierarchical imputations"
format: html
---

- Event indicators and both Nelson–Aalen hazards inform imputation [@Bonneville2022, sec. 4.1]
- Not SMC-FCS: compatibility with the survival model is approximate

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(mice)
library(miceadds)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
# The passive MICE methods below call these helpers by name.
source(here("R", "covariates.R"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "06-best-supportive-care", "results")
imputation_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "imputations")
dir.create(imputation_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

m <- config$imputation$m_supporting

prepared <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet"))
```

## Adjusted (fixed)

```{r}
#| label: impute-fixed
#| include: false
fixed_data <- prepared |>
  mutate(
    ecog_binary = derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt),
    mgps = derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein),
    ecog_fstcnt = ordered(ecog_fstcnt),
    gender = factor(gender),
    na_bsc = nelsonaalen(prepared, time_to_bsc_days, event_bsc),
    na_death = nelsonaalen(prepared, time_to_bsc_days, event_death_before_bsc)
  ) |>
  # Passive variables go last so they update after their sources.
  relocate(ecog_binary, mgps, .after = last_col())

fixed_columns <- c(
  "id", "tx", "time_to_bsc_days", "event_bsc", "event_death_before_bsc",
  "event_bsc_or_death", "na_bsc", "na_death"
)

fixed_methods <- make.method(fixed_data)
fixed_methods[fixed_columns] <- ""
fixed_methods["ecog_fstcnt"] <- "polr"
fixed_methods["ecog_binary"] <- "~I(derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt))"
fixed_methods["mgps"] <- "~I(derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein))"

fixed_predictors <- make.predictorMatrix(fixed_data)
fixed_predictors[fixed_columns, ] <- 0
fixed_predictors[
  ,
  c("id", "time_to_bsc_days", "event_bsc_or_death", "ecog_binary", "mgps")
] <- 0

fixed_path <- file.path(imputation_dir, "fixed.rds")

if (!file.exists(fixed_path)) {
  imputation <- mice(
    fixed_data,
    method = fixed_methods,
    predictorMatrix = fixed_predictors,
    m = m,
    maxit = config$imputation$maxit,
    donors = config$imputation$donors,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 1700,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )
  saveRDS(imputation, fixed_path, compress = "xz")
}

fixed_imputation <- readRDS(fixed_path)

for (index in seq_len(m)) {
  completed <- complete(fixed_imputation, index)

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(completed[c("tx", "ecog_binary", "stage_binary", "lung", "mgps")]),
    all(as.integer(as.character(completed$ecog_binary)) ==
          derive_ecog_binary(completed$ecog_fstcnt)),
    all(as.integer(as.character(completed$mgps)) ==
          derive_mgps(completed$albumin, completed$c_reactive_protein))
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-bsc-imputation-traces
#| fig-cap: "MICE traces for the five Adjusted (fixed) BSC imputations"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9
#| echo: false
plot_mice_traces(mice_chain_stats(fixed_imputation))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-bsc-imputation-distributions
#| fig-cap: "Observed and imputed laboratory measurements for the Adjusted (fixed) BSC branch"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false
laboratory_variables <- c(
  Albumin = "albumin",
  Bilirubin = "bilirubin",
  "C-reactive protein" = "c_reactive_protein",
  "Lactate dehydrogenase" = "lactate_dehydrogenase"
)

fixed_laboratory_values <- imputed_values(fixed_imputation, laboratory_variables)
plot_imputed_densities(
  fixed_laboratory_values$observed,
  fixed_laboratory_values$imputed
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bsc-imputation-events
#| tbl-cap: "Logged MICE events for the Adjusted (fixed) branch, if any"
#| echo: false
if (!is.null(fixed_imputation$loggedEvents)) {
  fixed_imputation$loggedEvents |>
    count(dep, meth, out, name = "logged_events") |>
    kable()
}
```

## Adjusted (hierarchical)

```{r}
#| label: impute-hierarchical
#| include: false
diagnoses <- here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet") |>
  read_parquet() |>
  select(id, diagnosis)

hierarchical_prepared <- prepared |>
  select(-lung) |>
  left_join(diagnoses, by = "id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  mutate(
    diagnosis = factor(diagnosis),
    diagnosis_id = as.integer(diagnosis),
    gender = factor(gender)
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(hierarchical_prepared$diagnosis),
  nrow(hierarchical_prepared) > 0L,
  !anyDuplicated(hierarchical_prepared$id)
)

hierarchical_data <- hierarchical_prepared |>
  mutate(
    na_bsc = nelsonaalen(hierarchical_prepared, time_to_bsc_days, event_bsc),
    na_death = nelsonaalen(
      hierarchical_prepared,
      time_to_bsc_days,
      event_death_before_bsc
    )
  ) |>
  select(-diagnosis)

hierarchical_incomplete <- names(which(colSums(is.na(hierarchical_data)) > 0))

hierarchical_methods <- make.method(hierarchical_data)
hierarchical_methods[] <- ""
# ECOG is imputed with a numeric working model.
hierarchical_methods[hierarchical_incomplete] <- "2l.pmm"

hierarchical_predictors <- make.predictorMatrix(hierarchical_data)
hierarchical_predictors[, c("id", "time_to_bsc_days", "event_bsc_or_death")] <- 0
hierarchical_predictors[!names(hierarchical_methods) %in% hierarchical_incomplete, ] <- 0
# -2 marks diagnosis_id as the cluster variable.
hierarchical_predictors[hierarchical_incomplete, "diagnosis_id"] <- -2

hierarchical_path <- file.path(imputation_dir, "hierarchical.rds")

if (!file.exists(hierarchical_path)) {
  imputation <- mice(
    hierarchical_data,
    method = hierarchical_methods,
    predictorMatrix = hierarchical_predictors,
    m = m,
    maxit = config$imputation$maxit,
    donors = config$imputation$donors,
    seed = 2701L,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )
  saveRDS(imputation, hierarchical_path)
}

hierarchical_imputation <- readRDS(hierarchical_path)

stopifnot(
  hierarchical_imputation$m == m,
  all(
    hierarchical_imputation$predictorMatrix[hierarchical_incomplete, "diagnosis_id"] == -2
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: complete-hierarchical
#| include: false
hierarchical_completed <- map(seq_len(m), function(index) {
  completed <- complete(hierarchical_imputation, index) |>
    mutate(
      diagnosis = hierarchical_prepared$diagnosis,
      ecog_binary = derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt),
      mgps = factor(derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein), levels = 0:2)
    )

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(completed),
    all(completed$ecog_fstcnt %in% 0:4),
    all(as.integer(as.character(completed$ecog_binary)) ==
          derive_ecog_binary(completed$ecog_fstcnt)),
    all(as.integer(as.character(completed$mgps)) ==
          derive_mgps(completed$albumin, completed$c_reactive_protein))
  )

  completed
})

saveRDS(
  hierarchical_completed,
  file.path(imputation_dir, "hierarchical-completed.rds")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-bsc-diagnosis-imputation-traces
#| fig-cap: "MICE traces for the Adjusted (hierarchical) BSC imputations"
#| fig-alt: "Means and standard deviations of imputed ECOG and laboratory values over 50 MICE iterations, with a separate trace for each of five diagnosis-level imputations."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9
#| echo: false
plot_mice_traces(mice_chain_stats(hierarchical_imputation))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-bsc-diagnosis-imputation-distributions
#| fig-cap: "Observed and imputed laboratory measurements for the Adjusted (hierarchical) BSC branch"
#| fig-alt: "Density curves compare observed laboratory measurements with each of the five completed diagnosis-level imputations for albumin, bilirubin, CRP, and LDH."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false
hierarchical_laboratory_values <- imputed_values(
  hierarchical_imputation,
  laboratory_variables
)
plot_imputed_densities(
  hierarchical_laboratory_values$observed,
  hierarchical_laboratory_values$imputed
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bsc-diagnosis-imputation-events
#| tbl-cap: "Logged MICE events for the Adjusted (hierarchical) branch, if any"
#| echo: false
if (!is.null(hierarchical_imputation$loggedEvents)) {
  hierarchical_imputation$loggedEvents |>
    count(dep, meth, out, name = "logged_events") |>
    kable()
}
```
